title: Takeoff — Genève LSGG
description: Helvetic Airways E190 parked at gate 10, Genève, bound for München. Live METAR. Cold start, pushback and taxi to runway 22 — mountains ahead.
author: Markus Leutwyler

atcClearances.pm: Helvetic, startup approved, IFR to München, squawk 4712
atcClearances.atc: Helvetic, startup approved, clearance to München EDDM, flight level two four zero, departure heading two one zero, squawk four seven one two
Helvetic, taxi to holding point runway two two via Foxtrot and November

atcClearances.pm: Holding point runway two two, ready
atcClearances.atc: Helvetic, line up and wait runway two two, one departure ahead
Helvetic, wind two three zero at ten, runway two two, cleared for takeoff

debrief: Was the takeoff roll smooth on runway 22?
Did you maintain runway heading until 1000ft AGL?
Lake Geneva appeared off the right — did you see it?
Mont Blanc is visible at 12 o'clock — how clear was it?
